name: UNiDAYS
category: Verification platforms (the fastest way to unlock most of these)
description: Browse offers from participating brands after verifying student eligibility. Each brand sets its own terms and verification requirements.

name: Student Beans
category: Verification platforms (the fastest way to unlock most of these)
description: Browse student offers and verify eligibility with Student Beans. Savings, exclusions and verification requirements vary by brand.

name: SheerID student verification
category: Verification platforms (the fastest way to unlock most of these)
description: Some brands use SheerID to confirm student eligibility. Start with the brand’s offer page and follow its verification steps; requirements vary by offer.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud
description: Discounted Creative Cloud Pro subscription for eligible students and teachers. Verify with a school email or accepted enrollment documents; introductory and renewal prices differ.

name: Office 365 Education
description: Eligible students and educators can access Office 365 A1, including web versions of core Office apps. Desktop app access depends on your school’s license; verify eligibility before buying.

name: Prime for Young Adults
description: Amazon's discounted Prime membership for eligible young adults and higher-education students. Verification can use age or student enrollment; a .edu address is not the only route.

name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
description: A bundle of developer tools and partner offers for verified students. Individual offers have their own eligibility rules, usage limits and expiration dates.

name: Figma Education
description: Verified students and educators in eligible educational programs can create an Education team with Professional-tier access. School-managed access has separate requirements.

name: Canva Campus / Free Canva
description: Canva Education is free for eligible K–12 schools and their students. College students should check whether their institution provides Canva Campus; a college email alone does not unlock free Pro.

name: Codecademy student discount
description: Codecademy Pro Student provides eligible students discounted access to the coding curriculum. Check current annual pricing, trial and verification terms.

name: Notion for Education
description: Eligible college and university students or teachers can get a free Education plan for a one-member workspace using an institution email. Annual verification is required; student organizations apply separately.

name: LinkedIn Learning via your library
description: Participating libraries provide LinkedIn Learning at no additional cost to patrons. Check your library’s website for its login link, card and PIN requirements.

name: Spotify Premium Student
description: Discounted U.S. Premium Student plan currently includes Hulu with ads, subject to eligibility. Student status is verified through SheerID and renewed annually; the student offer has a four-year limit.

name: Apple Music Student
description: Discounted Apple Music for eligible higher-education students, with Apple TV access subject to the current offer. Check eligibility and renewal terms on Apple's site.

name: YouTube Premium Student
description: Discounted YouTube Premium for students at eligible higher education institutions. SheerID verification and annual re-verification are required, for up to four consecutive years.

name: Disney+, Hulu Student Bundle
description: An ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu bundle for eligible U.S. college and graduate students age 18+. Enrollment is verified through SheerID and must be re-verified annually.

name: Amtrak student fares
description: Amtrak offers student fares with age, route, fare-class, advance-purchase and ID requirements. Check the current national or regional offer before booking.

name: BYOjet for Students (formerly StudentUniverse)
description: StudentUniverse now operates as BYOjet for Students. The booking service advertises fares for students, young adults and other travelers; availability and restrictions vary by itinerary.

name: Local transit discounts
description: Check your school and local transit agency for student fares or campus pass programs. Eligibility, enrollment verification and required fare cards vary; a school ID alone may not qualify.

name: Apple Education Pricing
description: Apple’s U.S. Education Store offers special pricing on eligible products for qualifying education customers. Check current eligibility, purchase limits and terms before ordering.

name: Nike Student Discount
description: Eligible U.S. students age 16+ can verify through SheerID for a single-use discount code on eligible Nike.com and Nike App purchases. Product exclusions apply.

name: Samsung Education Store
description: Samsung’s Education Offer Program provides eligible students and educators access to selected offers. Verification can use a school email or ID.me; product exclusions and terms apply.

name: Dell Student Discount
description: Dell’s Education Purchase Program offers eligible students and teachers additional savings. A Dell account, Dell Rewards enrollment and status verification are required; exclusions apply.

name: HP Education Store
description: HP's dedicated education storefront offers reduced pricing on laptops for verified students.

name: Under Armour Student Discount
description: Under Armour’s official student offer uses UNiDAYS verification for an extra online discount. Check current exclusions and checkout terms.

name: Walmart+ Student Discount
description: Eligible college and graduate students can receive 50% off a Walmart+ monthly or annual membership after verification. Membership renews and benefit restrictions apply.

name: Headspace for Students
description: Paid student subscription for eligible college and university students age 18+. Verify enrollment through SheerID and check current annual pricing and renewal terms.

name: Peloton App Student Membership
description: Verified university students can access special pricing on eligible Peloton App plans. Check membership tier, verification and current renewal pricing.

name: DoorDash DashPass for Students
description: Verified university and post-secondary students can subscribe at the student rate. Delivery benefits apply only to participating merchants and qualifying order minimums; other fees may apply.

name: T-Mobile Student Discounts
description: Dedicated Student Perks plans for eligible college students age 18+ who are the primary account holder. Verify enrollment within 45 days and re-verify annually; taxes, fees and plan requirements apply.

name: Chase Secure Banking
description: Chase Secure Banking waives its monthly service fee for account owners ages 17–24. Account approval and other fees apply; review current terms. Chase College Checking is no longer offered to new applicants.
